accuracy_scale.meaning: the phone reports this many times its true accuracy (1 = right on average, below 1 = over-confident)

accuracy_spread.meaning: sigma of the lognormal noise on the reported accuracy

clustering.meaning: share of hazards that sit in clusters of this mean size (0 = uniform hazards)

standoff_max_m.meaning: the reporter stands 1 to this many metres from the hazard (the matcher assumes about 4 m)

uniform_density.meaning: hazards with no clustering at all (Poisson), at this many per km2: the main run's densities without the bunching
